Hero.title: Erik Elias
Hero.subtitle: Full Stack developer working with Next.js and TypeScript, from the front-end to the API.
Hero.role: Open to Full Stack roles · freelancing at The GRAW Design

Experience.graw_desc: I joined The GRAW Design, André Gonçalves's design studio, at his invitation after he designed my Elle Fanning portfolio. When a client comes in, I turn the studio's layouts into websites, from the animations to the WebGL scenes. Right now I'm building the site for Naturallis, a store for compounded formulas, in Next.js 16, GSAP and Three.js, plus the studio's new site. I also set up the CI for both projects, which runs lint and type checks before every deploy. The work is per project, so I'm still available for a full-time role.
Experience.i9_desc: I was part of the team that built a management system for the construction industry from scratch, covering projects, companies and employees. I built the front-end in Next.js and TypeScript, with Context API for global state and Zod to validate data and forms. We used Git and GitHub for version control.
Experience.senac_desc: I was on the team that built an app for the Mossoró workers' union, to organize internal processes and communication with members. I built the front-end in React Native and TypeScript and helped with the API, made with Express and Prisma.
Experience.claro_desc: I worked at Claro's customer service center on financial support, handling questions and problems with invoices, payments and services. That's where I learned to solve problems under pressure and to explain things clearly.

Education.certs: TypeScript track at Alura (in progress), Docker and Docker Compose at Alura (in progress), Java and Spring Boot track at Alura (in progress), Systems Developer at Senac (completed), Web Developer at Senac, APIs with Node.js and Express at Alura, React with TailwindCSS at Alura

Skills.frontend: Next.js, React, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, Context API, HTML, CSS
Skills.backend: Node.js, Express, Prisma, Django, Spring Boot, Java, Python, PostgreSQL
Skills.tools: Docker, Docker Compose, Git, GitHub, Zod, Claude (Anthropic)

Projects.ellefanning_desc: A fan-made editorial portfolio about Elle Fanning's career that I also use as a creative front-end lab. On the opening screen, thousands of 3D blocks in Three.js form her portrait and ripple under the cursor. In the filmography, the posters pass between the two halves of the word like a film reel as you scroll. I wrote every effect by hand: WebGL shaders, spring physics, sound with the Web Audio API and a liquid glass cursor built with SVG filters. André Gonçalves, from The GRAW Design, did the design.
Projects.kiresaile_desc: An e-commerce landing page for KIRESAILE, a women's fashion brand I made up for this project, built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4. A WebGL fragment shader distorts and animates a fabric video in real time on the GPU. It has a working shopping cart and an editorial look in black, white and electric blue.
Projects.bmw_desc: I built this project to practice scrollytelling, where scrolling drives the animations and tells a story. The theme is the BMW X6 M Competition: each stretch of the scroll shows a detail of the car, from the exterior to the engine.
